name: Wappi

empty.title: Hi, I'm Wappi
empty.description: Ask about devices, your bill, the weather or a savings plan. Every figure is computed by tools from your home's data; I only explain it.

message.thinking: Wappi is reading your home's data

copilot_unavailable.title: Wappi can't answer right now
copilot_unavailable.body: The AI service is busy or unreachable. Any figures found are below; ask again in a few minutes.

copilot_rate_limited.title: That's a lot of questions
copilot_rate_limited.body: Up to 20 questions a minute. Wait a moment, then ask again.

conversation_not_found.title: Conversation not found
conversation_not_found.body: It may have been deleted. Start a new conversation.

other.title: Something went wrong
other.body: Ask again; if it keeps failing, reload the page.

session.title: Your session has ended
session.body: Reload the page to sign in again, then ask again.

consent_required.title: Wappi needs your agreement first
consent_required.body: Wappi can only answer if you let it send your question and the figures it needs to an outside AI service. The other pages work as usual.

message.aiNote: AI-generated from your home's data; it may be inaccurate.

cycle.title: This cycle against the same days of the last

plan.title: Wappi's suggested plan
plan.saving: Energy saved to the cycle's end
plan.note: Open the plan page to see what these save together, pick a start day and start.

voice.title: Talk to Wappi
voice.hint: Tap to talk; Wappi sends when you stop and answers out loud.
voice.unavailable: Voice is not available (the service is not set up).

suggestions.devices: Which device uses the most power?
suggestions.bill: Why is this cycle's bill higher than the last?
suggestions.forecast: How much will I pay at the cycle's end?
suggestions.weather: It's hot today. How should I use power?
suggestions.standby: What is background load, and is mine high?

loadFailed.title: Couldn't open this conversation
loadFailed.body: The network or the server may be busy.

privacy.title: Your message has personal details
privacy.body: It seems to include {kinds}. Wappi does not need them to answer. If you send it, they are replaced by labels such as [phone number] before it is stored or sent to the AI.

consent.failed: Your choice was not saved. Please try again.

wappi.title: Let Wappi use an outside AI?
wappi.description: To answer, Wappi asks an outside AI service. Here is what gets sent.
wappi.what: Your question, the open conversation and the figures about your home's electricity needed to answer, at your home's level of detail (daily or hourly).
wappi.to: OpenRouter, a service that passes the question to an AI model. When OpenRouter is down, the provider AstralX answers instead.
wappi.where: OpenRouter is outside Vietnam; AstralX processes it on its own servers.
wappi.note: WattPrint asks OpenRouter to use only processors that keep nothing and do not train on the data. This request cannot yet be made to AstralX.
wappi.off: In Settings. Once off, Wappi stops answering until you agree again.

voice.title: Let Wappi listen and read aloud?
voice.description: Your voice is sent to an outside service to turn it into text and read answers aloud.
voice.what: A recording of your voice, and the text of the answer to be read aloud. What you said, once turned into text and sent to Wappi, is handled like a typed question.
voice.to: The provider AstralX: speech to text, and reading answers aloud.
voice.note: Personal details cannot be hidden in a recording: whatever you say, such as a phone number or address, is sent as it is.
voice.off: In Settings. Once off, the microphone and voice mode stop working.

required.title: Wappi needs your agreement first
required.description: Wappi can only answer if you let it send your question and the figures it needs to an outside AI service. The other pages work as usual.

unread.title: Your choice could not be checked
unread.body: Wappi has sent nothing. Try again in a few minutes.

notice: Your question and the figures needed to answer it go to OpenRouter (outside Vietnam), or to AstralX when OpenRouter is down.

feedback.share: Also send the question and answer to the maintainers
